Definition: from G575 and G4155; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth):--choke.
BiblicalUsage: Twice in Luke, and both times about choking. Some seed fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up with it and choked it in Luke 8:7; and the herd of swine ran violently down the steep place into the lake and were choked in Luke 8:33.
TheologicalSignificance: The same word chokes a seed and drowns a herd — what grows beside the seed can kill it.
